mapper.select: SELECT id, username, password, name, user_type AS userType, image, email, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM user WHERE username = #{username}
SELECT id, username, password, name, user_type AS userType, image, email, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM user WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET name = #{name}, image = #{image}, email = #{email}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE user SET password = #{password}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user(username, password, name, user_type, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{username}, #{password}, #{name}, #{userType}, NOW(), NOW())
